QUOTE: Handlers do not write directly. The path is: ... calls `ServerDataOperatorBase.execute(...)` ... `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` ... does the actual write
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says handler writes go through `batchRecords` via `execute`, but it never states the reason: that each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`. It also hedges by saying "all server handlers that go through `execute`".
